# netbox_device_interfaces (Data Source)

Fetches a list of Device Interfaces from Netbox.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (Number) Filter by device ID.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Filter by enabled state.
- `name` (String) Filter by interface name.
- `type` (String) Filter by interface type.

### Read-Only

- `device_interfaces` (Attributes List) List of device interfaces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device_interfaces))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--device_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `device_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description for the interface.
- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the interface is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the interface.
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the interface.
- `mtu` (Number) The MTU of the interface.
- `name` (String) The name of the interface.
- `type` (String) The interface type.
